D: A teen with no powers becomes a superhero and teams up with Hit-Girl and Big Daddy.
P: Serve the mains when Kick-Ass meets Hit-Girl.
S: Popcorn popped in coconut oil, tossed while hot with melted butter, finely grated parmesan and cracked black pepper, in paper bags.
Dave's walk to school through Manhattan
Soft rolls with fried eggs and melted American cheese, salt, pepper and hot sauce, wrapped in foil.
Sweet rockmelon wrapped in prosciutto with basil and cracked pepper. Cut half a rockmelon into 20 cubes.
M: Big thin-crust New York slices with tomato sauce and mozzarella, folded in half to eat, garlic powder and chilli flakes on the side.
the treat Big Daddy promises Mindy
Two thin patties smashed on a smoking griddle, American cheese, pickles and burger sauce on toasted buns, double-fried chips alongside.
W: Mindy's reward for doing her training
Vanilla and chocolate ice cream with hot fudge (dark chocolate melted with cream), whipped cream, sprinkles and a cherry in a tall glass.
K: Grape juice and soda water over ice with frozen grapes as ice cubes, deep purple.

s.how: Heat 2 tbsp coconut oil with 3 kernels, then add 120g kernels once they pop, cover and shake until the popping slows. Toss with 50g melted butter, 40g finely grated parmesan and plenty of cracked pepper. Fill four paper bags.
Cut half a rockmelon into 20 cubes. Wrap each in a strip of prosciutto (150g total), add a small basil leaf and a twist of pepper and secure with a toothpick.

m.note: the treat Big Daddy promises Mindy
m.how: Mix 100g mayo, 2 tbsp relish and 1 tsp mustard for sauce. Smash 8 thin patties from 800g mince on a smoking griddle, add American cheese and stack two per toasted bun with pickles and sauce. Fry 1kg potato chips twice and salt.

w.note: Mindy's reward for doing her training
w.how: Melt 100g dark chocolate with 100ml cream. Layer scoops of vanilla and chocolate ice cream in four tall glasses with the hot fudge. Finish with whipped cream, sprinkles and a cherry on top.

d.how: Freeze 250g seedless grapes for 2 hours. Fill 4 glasses with the frozen grapes and ice, add 150ml grape juice to each and top with 100ml soda water.
